hooks.command: session_folder=$(tr -d '\n' | sed -n 's/.*"cwd"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*"\([^"]*\)".*/\1/p'); for git_folder in "$session_folder" "$PWD" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; do [ -n "$git_folder" ] && { git -C "$git_folder" config --worktree core.hooksPath .githooks 2>/dev/null || git -C "$git_folder" config core.hooksPath .githooks 2>/dev/null; }; done; true
hooks.statusMessage: Wiring the repository git hooks in this session's worktree
